user.title: Bravia TV (gRPC)
user.description: Enter the IP address of your BRAVIA TV. The gRPC control port is discovered automatically.

oauth.title: Sign in to Sony
oauth.description:
1. **[Open the Sony sign-in page]({auth_url})** in a **desktop browser** (not the phone that has BRAVIA Connect) and log in with the Sony account paired to your TV.
2. Sign-in redirects to an `ssh-app://signin?code=…` address; the page will look like it failed — that’s expected.
3. Copy that full `ssh-app://…` address and paste it below. If the address bar doesn’t show it, open the browser’s DevTools (F12) → **Network** tab and copy the `Location` header of the last `302` request. Pasting just the `code=…` value also works.

error.no_grpc_service: Could not find the gRPC control service on that host. Make sure the TV is on and reachable.
error.oauth_failed: The Sony login redirect could not be validated. Try again.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed while fetching device keys. See the logs for details.

abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different TV. Sign in with the Sony account paired to this TV.
abort.not_a_tv: That device is a Sony soundbar, not a TV. This integration controls BRAVIA TVs; use the Bravia Theatre (bravia_quad) integration for the soundbar.

init.title: Bravia TV options
init.description: The gRPC control port is discovered automatically. Set it here only if discovery fails on your network and you know the TV's current port; 0 restores automatic discovery.

data.agent_update_checks: Check for HA TV Agent updates
data.agent_manifest_url: Agent release manifest URL (blank = the agent release paired with this integration)
data.picture_event_refresh: Refresh picture settings on TV events

data_description.rest_psk: Leave empty for read-only picture settings. To change them from Home Assistant, set a key on the TV: in its network settings under IP control, set Authentication to Normal and Pre-Shared Key and enter a Pre-Shared Key, then enter the same key here. Remote device settings → Control remotely must be on. The key is passed to the HA TV Agent on the TV, which uses it locally.
data_description.picture_poll_s: How often the HA TV Agent re-reads the picture settings while the TV is on. 60 s is recommended; shorter intervals put more load on the TV. Every picture setting is enabled by default: disable the entities you do not use.
data_description.picture_event_refresh: Re-read immediately when the picture mode, input, content mode or HDR state changes.
data_description.agent_update_checks: Show an update entity for the HA TV Agent when a new agent is available. Updates are never installed on their own: installing needs the Install button in Home Assistant and a confirmation on the TV. The version offered is the one paired with this integration release, so agent updates arrive together with integration updates. Turn off to stop checking (no requests to GitHub).
data_description.agent_manifest_url: Leave empty to use the agent release paired with this integration. Set it only to serve the agent from somewhere else, for example a file Home Assistant serves itself.

exec_rejected.message: The TV rejected the change to {path}. It may not be available in the current context (for example the setting's input, app, or audio output isn't active).

cloud_rejected.message: The TV rejected the cloud command for {name}: {reason}.

cloud_unreachable.message: Could not send {name} through the Sony cloud: {reason}.

cloud_invalid_value.message: {name}: {value} is not one of the values the TV advertises ({allowed})

agent_setup_complete.message: Nothing to set up: the HA TV Agent on {name} already has every permission it needs.

agent_offline.message: The HA TV Agent on {name} is not connected; the TV may be off.

rest_key_rejected.message: The TV rejected the IP control key for {name}. Check that the key in the integration options matches the TV's Pre-Shared Key.

rest_unavailable.message: IP control on {name} is not answering. Check that Remote device settings → Control remotely is on on the TV.

grpc_port_unreachable.title: Bravia TV not reachable
grpc_port_unreachable.description: Home Assistant couldn't find the Sony gRPC control service on {host}. Make sure the TV is powered on and on the same network. If mDNS and port scanning are blocked on your network, set the port manually in the integration's options (Settings > Devices & Services > Bravia TV > Configure).

agent_permissions.title: HA TV Agent on {name} needs permissions
agent_permissions.description: The HA TV Agent is running on {name} but has not been granted: {missing}. Now-playing needs Notification access, the remote's battery needs Bluetooth, and updating the agent from Home Assistant needs permission to install unknown apps. Press the **Agent setup** button on the TV's device page, then accept the prompts on the TV with the remote, or open the HA TV Agent app on the TV and follow its status screen.

rest_key_rejected.title: IP control key rejected by {name}
rest_key_rejected.description: The pre-shared key in the integration options is not accepted by {name}, so picture settings cannot be changed. On the TV, check the Pre-Shared Key under IP control in the network settings (Authentication must be Normal and Pre-Shared Key), then enter the same key in the integration options, or clear it there for read-only picture settings.

rest_unavailable.title: IP control on {name} is not reachable
rest_unavailable.description: The HA TV Agent cannot reach the TV's IP control, so picture settings are unavailable. On the TV, check that Remote device settings → Control remotely is on (it switches the TV's IP control off for every app, not only Home Assistant).

agent_outdated.title: HA TV Agent on {name} needs an update
agent_outdated.description: {name} runs HA TV Agent {installed}, but this version of the integration needs {required} or later. Until it is updated, changing most picture settings fails (only picture mode, brightness, colour, contrast, hue, sharpness, local dimming, colour temperature, colour space and HDR mode can be changed). Update the agent from its update entity on the TV's device page and confirm on the TV, or install the release with adb.

search.name: Search
search.description: Show Sony's on-screen search results for a query (via the Sony cloud). Takes over the screen and audio focus.

play.name: Play
play.description: Ask the TV to play the best match instead of showing results (only acts on a confident match).
